in_hebrew.name: Hampton
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hampton הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘heah’ (high) + ‘ham’ (homestead, town). The name Hampton can be interpreted as ‘handsome town’. The name was common in England during the Middle Ages and was often given to children born in or near a town or settlement.
